cards.oracleText:

cards.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You get {E}{E} (two energy counters).

cards.oracleText: Return this enchantment to its owner's hand: Draw three cards, then discard four cards.

cards.name: Harmless Assault
cards.oracleText: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by attacking creatures.

cards.name: Harmonized Trio // Brainstorm
cards.oracleText:
{T}, Tap two untapped creatures you control: This creature becomes prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
Draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.

cards.name: Harmattan Efreet
cards.oracleText:
Flying

cards.name: Harmonious Emergence
cards.oracleText:
Enchant land you control
Enchanted land is a 4/5 green Spirit creature with vigilance and haste. It's still a land.
If enchanted land would be destroyed, instead sacrifice this Aura and that land gains indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Harmonic Sliver

cards.name: Harmonic Prodigy
cards.oracleText:
Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
If a triggered ability of a Shaman or another Wizard you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.

cards.oracleText:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)

Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.)
Harmonious Grovestrider's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
